# Shade cloth for people as well as plants

The community bed has a tap but nowhere to rest in the shade. Older volunteers work early and leave before newcomers arrive, so advice travels through whoever happens to overlap. Added two chairs under the tree before buying more plants. [[Garden notebook]]: the conditions for gardening include the bodies doing it, not just sunlight and soil.
